description: Land Title Settlement Department - Meegasthenna, Redeegama D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420047
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (Land No. 176 and 193) with detailed property descriptions, cadastral map references, and ownership details. The content focuses entirely on land settlement and title registration processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
